title: Element desktop data
whyItMatters: Element keeps the Matrix session, room list, message cache and encryption keys on disk. With the unencrypted store it is a readable history of the person's chats.
source: Element Desktop docs, user-specified config.json: on Linux the app directory is $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Element: https://web-docs.element.dev/readme-element-desktop.html
notes: The folder is named Element; start it with --profile Work and it becomes Element-Work, and pre-1.7 installs used Riot and Riot-<profile>. The homeserver address is also recorded in config.json. The Flatpak uses ~/.var/app/im.riot.Riot/config/Element.
